_readme: Places for the Places tab that Visit Columbia's directory leaves out, or describes badly. A row here replaces a directory row with the same name. category: fun, outdoors, culture, coffee, nightlife, shopping. lat/lng are looked up from the address when left out.

places.name: Rock Bridge Memorial State Park
places.blurb: A natural rock bridge, the Devil's Icebox cave boardwalk and eight trails, 15 minutes south of downtown. Free.

places.name: MKT Nature and Fitness Trail (Flat Branch trailhead)
places.blurb: The 8.9-mile rail trail starts at Flat Branch Park downtown and runs through the woods to the Katy Trail. Flat, shaded and free.

places.name: Katy Trail, McBaine Trailhead
places.blurb: Where the MKT meets the Katy Trail: river bluffs, the huge Burr Oak tree nearby, and 240 miles of trail in both directions.

places.name: Laws Observatory
places.address: Physics Building, 701 S College Ave, Columbia, MO 65201
places.blurb: Mizzou's rooftop telescopes are open to everyone on Wednesday nights, 8 to 10 PM, when the sky is clear. Free.

places.name: Valhalla's Gate
places.blurb: Game store with tables for Magic, D&D, Warhammer and board games, and open game nights most evenings.

places.name: Hexagon Alley
places.blurb: Board game cafe and bar downtown with a library of hundreds of games, trivia on Tuesdays and card game nights.

places.name: Pierpont General Store
places.blurb: Historic 1889 general store near Rock Bridge with two kitchens, a backroad bar and live music under the trees.

places.name: Francis Quadrangle
places.address: Francis Quadrangle, University of Missouri, Columbia, MO 65201
places.blurb: Mizzou's historic quad, the six Columns and Jesse Hall. The classic Columbia photo spot, lit up at night.

places.name: Peace Park
places.address: Elm St and S 8th St, Columbia, MO 65201
places.blurb: Shady little park between downtown and campus, with a creek and lawns for a break between classes.
